cases.name: Priscilla Castro
cases.about: Beautiful, strong, and loving – those three words are what Jasmine Castro will remember her sister by. "Loving, my sister would give you the shirt off her back. She would do anything for anybody," Jasmine explained.
cases.narrative: On 9/2/2020, her burned body was found near Lake Berryessa, in Napa County, CA. When he set her body on fire, he sparked a wildfire which also killed two men. Investigators believe "Serriteno deliberately set the Markley Fire in an attempt to conceal his crime," the sheriff's office said.

cases.name: Savannah Rae Theberge
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She loved to travel and explore the world. After moving to Utah, she worked for Amazon, as well as Fedex. In her spare time, Savannah loved hiking and swimming. She had a very creative and artistic soul, and was a joy to be around."

Her ex-boyfriend and father of her 4-year-old son, Brady Crahal, describes the mother of his child as a great person, very selfless and loving.
